properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the convex hull of the anchors (every outer-ring vertex of the named Natural Earth Geography Regions polygons, and a circle of 1° radius around each Natural Earth town), on Africa's land; Africa's land is the union of the Natural Earth Admin 0 countries whose CONTINENT is Africa; on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped. A people's area, never a state. The hull overstates: it takes in empty desert (Tanezrouft, Ténéré) and lands shared with Songhay, Zarma, Hausa, Arab and Tubu neighbours. It leaves out the Kinnin enclave in northern Darfur and the seasonal and modern migrations the fiche lists. Compared by eye with GREG (Weidmann, Rød and Cederman 2010, digitized from the Soviet Atlas Narodov Mira of 1964; no licence stated, so not used as geometry): the same core, but GREG reaches further north-east, to Ghadames and the Fezzan, and further east in Niger.
